_about: Reconciliation ledger for the register-completeness gate (verify_register_completeness.py). Every mandatory RFC-2119 keyword (MUST/MUST NOT/SHALL/SHALL NOT/REQUIRED) in the pinned prose spec must be a register row, OR listed here. This file is how we PROVE the coverage denominator is complete rather than assumed. Two kinds of entry: (1) scope_exclusions — a whole spec file whose obligations are structurally outside what a server-endpoint conformance checker can observe, or are non-normative documents (narrative/examples/templates/guides). (2) waivers — a single keyword line in an IN-SCOPE file that is a duplicate restatement, non-normative prose, or a prose MUST enforced by a schema row. A missed keyword that is neither covered by a row nor listed here FAILS the build. Reasons must be spec-grounded; a thin or bogus reason is itself rejected. A RETIRED entry is replaced IN PLACE by a note-only object, every key underscore prefixed: list indexes are the identity review_signoffs.json sample ids use, so an entry is never deleted (dd84fb4 proved why on 2026-10-27).
